title: Family exponent
statement: For natural numbers $C$ and $Q$, define the family exponent to be twice the degree coefficient times one more than the coordinate coefficient; explicitly, it is $2\bigl(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1\bigr)\bigl(128(Q+1)^2(C+1)^3+4(8(C+1)(Q+1)+1)+6\bigr)$.
